limitations: No daily database migration or seeding; app factory/startup/health integration remains C08. schema_ready means schema/role privileges only.
No email login/session/password hashing, HTTP identity/project authorization, CSRF, business API, React, real file bytes, actual OCR or worker startup.

App is a shared service role with broad SELECT/INSERT within the reviewed business tables; per-user/project authorization is a service responsibility. Owner/superuser DDL is outside this app-role boundary.
Strict raw JSON/JCS/hashes and files C09, idempotency HTTP replay/409 and archive/intake race C09/C10, supplied worker-token equality/acquisition C13, actual backup/restore C14 remain unverified.
Future mutation entry points must lock run then attempt before updating attempts; triggers cannot reorder native target-row locking.

Contract uses PostgreSQL 17 catalog formatting; another major/version/extension environment needs compatibility review. Runtime trusts packaged reviewed JSON; source fingerprints are checked by static tests.
Some denial tests intentionally affect zero rows to isolate SQL privileges; all 14 mutable tables, complete app graph, actual COMMIT rollback and lock races are also exercised on real rows.
No Windows/browser/GPU/RunPod/production load/durability tests or operational release claim.
